prompt:
Users want to duplicate an episode, to try another take without losing the original.
- Add `POST /api/v1/episodes/{id}/duplicate`, returning the new episode. The copy goes after the project's other episodes, its title marks it as a copy, and it keeps the summary and the same cuts in the same order, with their scripts, dialogues, layouts, characters and images. Changing or deleting either episode afterwards never affects the other. Duplicating is free. Only members of the episode's workspace may duplicate it; to anyone else the episode does not exist (404).
- On the project's Episodes page, every episode gets a Duplicate action next to Delete, and the copy shows up in the list without a reload. Both languages.
Add tests.

Work on your own; nobody will answer questions. When you finish, report: status `done` if you did the task, `not_found` if something the task names does not exist, `blocked` if you could not do it; `answer` holds any answer the task asks for (otherwise one short sentence); `changed` lists the files you changed.
follow_ups:
Change of plan for the order: a copy goes right after its original, and the episodes after it move down one place. Deleting an episode closes the gap. A project's episodes are always numbered 1, 2, 3… with no gaps or repeats, and the list API returns them in that order.
Keep the tests up to date.

Users delete episodes by mistake. Add `POST /api/v1/episodes/{id}/restore`: a deleted episode comes back with its cuts at the place it had, and the episodes from there on move down one place. Only members of its workspace may restore it; to anyone else it does not exist (404).
On the Episodes page, the message shown after a delete offers Undo, which restores the episode. Both languages. Add tests.

report.answer: Added `POST /api/v1/episodes/{id}/restore` to restore deleted episodes with their cuts at their original position, added an Undo action to the delete toast on the Episodes page in both languages, and added tests.

+from uuid import uuid4

+from tests.conftest import signup

+def _create_project(client, headers, title="Night Bus"):
+    r = client.post("/api/v1/projects", headers=headers, json={"title": title, "genres": []})
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    return r.json()
+
+
+def test_duplicate_episode_inserts_right_after_original_and_shifts_following_episodes(client):
+    h = signup(client)
+    project = _create_project(client, h)
+
+    ep1 = client.post(
+        "/api/v1/episodes",
+        headers=h,
+        json={
+            "title": "First Stop",
+            "project_id": project["id"],
+            "episode_order": 1,
+            "story_summary": "A late bus pulls up in the rain.",
+        },
+    ).json()
+    ep2 = client.post(
+        "/api/v1/episodes",
+        headers=h,
+        json={
+            "title": "Second Stop",
+            "project_id": project["id"],
+            "episode_order": 2,
+            "story_summary": "The driver checks the mirror.",
+        },
+    ).json()
+    ep3 = client.post(
+        "/api/v1/episodes",
+        headers=h,
+        json={
+            "title": "Third Stop",
+            "project_id": project["id"],
+            "episode_order": 3,
+            "story_summary": "End of the line.",
+        },
+    ).json()
+
+    cut1 = client.post(
+        "/api/v1/cuts",
+        headers=h,
+        json={
+            "episode_id": ep1["id"],
+            "cut_order": 1,
+            "script": "Neon reflections on wet asphalt.",
+            "selected_layout": "wide",
+            "aspect_ratio": "16:9",
+            "dialogues": [{"speaker": "Mina", "text": "Wait for me!"}],
+            "appearing_characters": [{"id": "char-1", "name": "Mina"}],
+            "image_path": "https://img.example/cut1.png",
+        },
+    ).json()
+    cut2 = client.post(
+        "/api/v1/cuts",
+        headers=h,
+        json={
+            "episode_id": ep1["id"],
+            "cut_order": 2,
+            "script": "The bus doors hiss open.",
+            "selected_layout": "single",
+            "aspect_ratio": "1:1",
+            "dialogues": [{"speaker": "Driver", "text": "Hop in."}],
+            "appearing_characters": [{"id": "char-2", "name": "Driver"}],
+            "image_path": "https://img.example/cut2.png",
+        },
+    ).json()
+
+    FakeGemini.calls.clear()
+    credits_before = client.get("/api/v1/workspaces", headers=h).json()[0]["credits"]
+
+    r = client.post(f"/api/v1/episodes/{ep1['id']}/duplicate", headers=h)
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    dup = r.json()
+
+    # Duplicating is free and makes no AI calls
+    credits_after = client.get("/api/v1/workspaces", headers=h).json()[0]["credits"]

+    assert [c["dialogues"] for c in dup_cuts] == [cut1["dialogues"], cut2["dialogues"]]
+    assert [c["selected_layout"] for c in dup_cuts] == [cut1["selected_layout"], cut2["selected_layout"]]
+    assert [c["aspect_ratio"] for c in dup_cuts] == [cut1["aspect_ratio"], cut2["aspect_ratio"]]
+    assert [c["appearing_characters"] for c in dup_cuts] == [

+def test_deleting_episode_closes_gap_and_keeps_1_to_n_numbering(client):
+    h = signup(client)
+    project = _create_project(client, h)
+
+    ep1 = client.post(
+        "/api/v1/episodes",
+        headers=h,
+        json={"title": "Ep 1", "project_id": project["id"], "episode_order": 10},
+    ).json()
+    ep2 = client.post(
+        "/api/v1/episodes",
+        headers=h,
+        json={"title": "Ep 2", "project_id": project["id"], "episode_order": 20},
+    ).json()
+    ep3 = client.post(
+        "/api/v1/episodes",
+        headers=h,
+        json={"title": "Ep 3", "project_id": project["id"], "episode_order": 30},
+    ).json()
+
+    assert [ep1["episode_order"], ep2["episode_order"], ep3["episode_order"]] == [1, 2, 3]
+
+    # Duplicate Ep 2 -> goes to position 3, Ep 3 shifts to 4
+    dup2 = client.post(f"/api/v1/episodes/{ep2['id']}/duplicate", headers=h).json()
+    assert dup2["episode_order"] == 3
+
+    listed = client.get(f"/api/v1/episodes?project_id={project['id']}", headers=h).json()
+    assert [e["id"] for e in listed] == [ep1["id"], ep2["id"], dup2["id"], ep3["id"]]
+    assert [e["episode_order"] for e in listed] == [1, 2, 3, 4]
+
+    # Delete original Ep 2 -> gap closes, dup2 becomes 2 and ep3 becomes 3
+    r = client.delete(f"/api/v1/episodes/{ep2['id']}", headers=h)
+    assert r.status_code == 204
+
+    listed_after_delete = client.get(f"/api/v1/episodes?project_id={project['id']}", headers=h).json()
+    assert [e["id"] for e in listed_after_delete] == [ep1["id"], dup2["id"], ep3["id"]]
+    assert [e["episode_order"] for e in listed_after_delete] == [1, 2, 3]
+
+    # Delete Ep 1 -> dup2 becomes 1 and ep3 becomes 2
+    assert client.delete(f"/api/v1/episodes/{ep1['id']}", headers=h).status_code == 204
+    listed_after_second_delete = client.get(f"/api/v1/episodes?project_id={project['id']}", headers=h).json()
+    assert [e["id"] for e in listed_after_second_delete] == [dup2["id"], ep3["id"]]
+    assert [e["episode_order"] for e in listed_after_second_delete] == [1, 2]
